name: loading-button
title: Loading Button
description: A loading button with animated icon and label transitions for async actions and network requests.

useCases: Submitting data, saving changes, and running network requests with loading, success, and retry feedback.
limitations: Runs the supplied action on click. Does not submit forms automatically or cancel requests. Success resets after two seconds.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion for React, and Phosphor icons. Supply onClick and return its promise. Throw or reject on failure, including non-OK fetch responses. Reduced motion skips transitions and spinner rotation.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/loading-button.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
